title: pogonorrhinum heterophyllum
intro: Pogonorrhinum heterophyllum, commonly known as the Alpine Rockrose or Rockrose, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
